summary: Frontend-only regression on Tapi Namastubhyam site. Verified images are now rendered in Hero, Activities (4), Heritage (aerial), News (3 thumbnails), and Gallery (6 tiles + lightbox opens). All images have naturalWidth > 0 (no broken assets). Also validated core booking flow at /book/aarti and donation flow at /donate — both reach their success screens with reference IDs.

issues: Overlay gradient (paper via paper/70) is fairly heavy on the left half, which slightly desaturates the hero photograph. Still readable and intentional, but the photograph is more visible on the right side than the left. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Hero uses only one plus stacked gradient overlays — z-index fix is working; hero image now visibly renders (sunset ghat scene).

All images observed loading from Unsplash or mgx-backend-cdn.metadl.com — ensure these external hosts remain accessible in production; consider adding loading="lazy" and width/height attrs for better CLS if not already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend flows verified via Playwright with reduced-motion emulation (bypasses Lenis). Hero image confirmed via evaluated naturalWidth=6000. Booking date picker exposes a react-day-picker grid; select day via [role=gridcell] button:not([disabled]). Donate page did not expose [data-testid^='donate-preset'] on this run but submission worked with default preset selection — main agent may want to double-check preset testids exist.
rca of the issue: N/A — reported bug (missing hero image + other section images) is resolved. Root cause was hero parallax layer using -z-10 behind an opaque paper background making the image invisible; changing to z-0 with translucent gradient overlays exposes the photo. Section images were added to data.js and rendered in Activities, Heritage, and News.
